method: Node VM integration: mocked DOM/window/pointer capture/RAF and real duel engine; not a real browser

checks.name: Directional jump and J airborne dispatch; I anti and O throw
Repeated and duplicate keydown cannot repeat attacks; keyup rearms input
Pointer cancel/lostcapture release movement and guard; multiple guard pointers
Blur freezes clock and clears held input; explicit release required after resume
Visibility hidden and pagehide suspend safely
Help and levels dialogs freeze play, suppress commands and resume only previously running game
V2 persistence isolated; airborne replay restores paused and advances only on resume
V1 progress and checkpoint are not restored into V2

manualReview: All nine touch buttons disabled outside playing state.
Jump and aerial clear old held input while engine jumpDir retains trajectory.
Help/level dialog close only resumes if opened during play.
Paused checkpoint resumes original jump trajectory without wall-clock catch-up.
limitations: No real browser, touch hardware, accessibility-tree, focus traversal or visual layout verification.
Mock pointer capture and synchronous close events do not establish real browser event ordering.
Home/v1 navigation target deployment availability is outside this controller test.
